profileEvidence.summary: Under its NKC standard, the Majestic Tree Hound is affectionate and sensitive to kindness or correction. Two-year-old Bull sought attention from anyone who offered it; his keeper described littermate Tank as intelligent and independent. The pair enjoyed country roaming and lawn lounging, but also chased deer for miles.
